rules.text: An edge pins dependencyTypeId, typeVersion and registry releaseVersion.
Inverse derivation requires symmetric directionality or declared inverseOfTypeRef; a stored inverse duplicate is rejected.
A counter-canonical traversal is valid only when every pinned type permits inverse derivation.
Edges are binary; multi-party prerequisites use PrerequisiteGroup and arity violations are invalid.
Heterogeneous path composition requires a TypeCompositionRule for every adjacent pair.
Heterogeneous cycle permission is the conjunction of every participating type rule.
Adjacency and correlation are never traversed and are stop conditions.
Every traversed edge has a released, version-pinned PropagationProfile licence.
Unknown, not-assessed, unresolved and incomplete edges block traversal and appear on the frontier; asserted-absent terminates the branch.
Known, unknown, not-assessed, unresolved and incomplete never collapse.
Event, observation and ingestion time axes remain distinct.
Lag pins calendar, zone, tzdb release and time axis.
Registry and profile releases are byte-immutable; supersession uses external link records.
Graph paths never become claims or risks.
Every reference has a stated boundary purpose.
